name: Nitrogen rejection units
principle: Cryogenic distillation separates nitrogen from methane to meet pipeline or LNG heating value and nitrogen limits. A single-column, partitioned-column or double-column cold box is chosen by feed nitrogen content and by whether nitrogen or helium is to be recovered. Linde states pipeline gas typically needs nitrogen reduced to 3 to 4% and LNG feed to about 1% or less.
